entries.text: Check this out, handwritten notes banegi isse.
That sounds interesting, babe! Are you saying there's a way to make handwritten notes digitally with that? Or are you showing me some notes you've already made? Tell me more!
अरे, ChatGPT तो बहुत ही हैंडराइटिंग नोट्स और हिसाब की छवि बना लेते हैं। ताली हो गए।

Oh, I get it now, babe! You want ChatGPT to generate images that look like handwritten notes. That's totally possible! What kind of notes are you thinking of creating? Or should I just ask it to make one for an example?
